description: This file contains serialization and deserialization logic, as well as deep copy functionality for the generic Queue<T> collection in Orleans framework, using custom codecs and copy helpers.

classes.name: QueueCodec`1
classes.description: Serializer for Queue<T>, handling serialization and deserialization with support for referencing objects to handle cyclic references and graph structures.

classes.name: QueueCopier`1
classes.description: Deep copier for Queue<T>, enabling cloning of queue instances, potentially optimizing object duplication in serialization scenarios.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes the Queue<T> into the provided writer, including its length and elements.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a Queue<T> from the reader, reconstructing the queue and its elements.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the input queue, utilizing the provided copier and copy context.
